lines.en: label mollydate35p1:
scene bedroom_day
Morning comes.
lines.zh: 清晨到来。

lines.en: And I receive a phone call.
lines.zh: 而我接到了一通电话。

lines.en: : Hel-
: Bal'a dash, malanore! Doral ana'diel?
lines.zh: : Bal'a dash, malanore! Doral ana'diel?

lines.en: : Sorry, wrong number.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，打错了。

lines.en: : How goes it, Sir? How fares thee?
lines.zh: : 近来可好，先生？您安好吗？

lines.en: : I would have liked to have slept a little longer before being woken up by whatever your language is called again.
lines.zh: : 我本来还想在被你们那种语言叫醒之前多睡一会儿的——管它又叫什么来着。

lines.en: : Irish. Or Gaelic. Technically Irish, but only because the damn Scots {i}stole{/i} Gaelic and we just keeled over and let ‘em.
lines.zh: : 爱尔兰语。或者盖尔语。严格来说是爱尔兰语，但只是因为那群该死的苏格兰人把盖尔语{i}偷走{/i}了，而我们干脆倒地装死随他们拿。

lines.en: : But what I was speaking just now was actually Thalassian- the language of the blood elves. Selama ashal'anore! Justice for our people!
lines.zh: : 不过我刚才说的其实是萨拉斯语——血精灵的语言。Selama ashal'anore！为了我们的人民讨回公道！

lines.en: : Why are you calling me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么打给我？

lines.en: : Because I refuse to have our rank drop down {i}again{/i} just because you’re not attracted to me!
lines.zh: : 因为我拒绝让我们的好感等级{i}再一次{/i}掉下去，就因为您对我没有欲望！

lines.en: : Also, I require aid- for my quest today is significantly harder without someone there to support me and the Kendo Princess has other matters she must tend to.
lines.zh: : 另外，我需要援助——今天这个任务没有人在旁边支援会难上许多，而剑道公主另有要事要处理。

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不——

lines.en: : Anar'alah, Sir! Act ‘yer feckin’ age! The Supreme Overlord I know isn’t perturbed by the presence of teenage girls! He steals their life force and converts it into mana!
lines.zh: : Anar'alah，先生！别他妈闹别扭了！我认识的至高霸主可不会被十几岁的女孩弄得局促不安！他偷走她们的生命力，把它转化成法力！

lines.en: : So we had an awkward night! Big deal! {i}Every{/i} night is awkward when you’re me and you’ll never survive in the outside world if you can’t come to terms with that!
lines.zh: : 我们昨晚是有点尴尬！那又怎样！像我这样的人，{i}哪一晚{/i}不尴尬——你要是连这点都接受不了，在外面根本活不下去！

lines.en: : You are probably the last person I want to lecture me on how to survive in the outside world.
lines.zh: : 你大概是我最不想听他讲「怎么在外面活下去」的人。

lines.en: : Well, stop making amateur mistakes and I won’t have to keep bringing up tooltips! You did this to yourself!
lines.zh: : 那就别再犯新手错误，这样我也不必一直跳提示框了！这都是您自找的！

lines.en: : How quickly can you make it to Silvermoon?
lines.zh: : 您最快多久能到银月城？

lines.en: : I...have no idea where that even is.
lines.zh: : 我……根本不知道那在哪儿。

lines.en: : Eversong Woods, just north of the East Sanctum.
lines.zh: : 永歌森林，东圣所以北。

lines.en: : Are we traveling to an alternate dimension?
lines.zh: : 我们这是要去异世界吗？

lines.en: : God, I wish. An isekai is exactly what I need right now. Preferably one where I’m extremely overpowered and have an entire harem at my disposal.
lines.zh: : 天啊，我真希望是。异世界正是我现在需要的。最好还是那种我强得离谱、还有一整个后宫任我差遣的。

lines.en: : Sounds exhausting.
lines.zh: : 听起来就累。

lines.en: : You would know, Sir. So, can you make it to the Entertainment District within the hour? Or should I open a portal to your home and retrieve you along the way?
lines.zh: : 您最清楚了，先生。那么，您能在一小时内赶到娱乐区吗？还是说我干脆开一道传送门到您家、顺路把您接走？

lines.en: : I can head over...but I’m still not sure if-
lines.zh: : 我可以过去……可我还是不确定——

lines.en: : Excellent! Shorel'aran, Sir! I’ll see you soon!
lines.zh: : 太好了！Shorel'aran，先生！我们很快见！

lines.en: : ...that’s a good idea.
lines.zh: : ……这是个好主意。

lines.en: scene sky
Molly hangs up the phone and, despite the sudden return of my uneasiness when it comes to being around her (Thanks, Haruka), I get dressed and start heading over to “Silvermoon.”
lines.zh: Molly 挂断了电话。尽管和她待在一起时那种不安感又突然回来了（多谢了，Haruka），我还是穿好衣服，动身前往「银月城」。

lines.en: It’s annoying, though. Things were going completely fine until the invisible girl-magnet inside of me started pulling Molly over. And it’s annoying that I’m so aware of that as well.
lines.zh: 不过这挺烦人的。本来一切都好好的，直到我体内那块隐形的「吸女磁铁」开始把 Molly 拽过来。而我也烦自己居然对此这么清楚。

lines.en: I want more than anything to return to the blissfully ignorant me who would have fucked her on Haruka’s couch prior to our dramatic fallout two Halloweens ago.
lines.zh: 我比什么都想回到那个幸福无知的我——那个在两个万圣节前我们决裂之前，会在 Haruka 的沙发上把她肏了的我。

lines.en: I want to see her the way she {i}wants{/i} me to see her...and carry through with those lust-driven ideas I proposed to her way back when.
lines.zh: 我想用她{i}希望{/i}我看她的方式看她……并且把我很久以前向她提议的那些被欲望驱使的想法贯彻到底。

lines.en: scene lavendersgreen6
But all I can see when I’m alone with her is this.
lines.zh: 可每当我和她单独相处时，我看到的只有这个。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom1
: Greetings, Sir! Thank you for clearing out some room in your quest journal. Your assistance is invaluable and I appreciate you in an entirely platonic, not-at-all sexually driven way!
lines.zh: : 您好，先生！感谢您为您的任务日志腾出空位。您的协助无比珍贵，而我以完全柏拉图式、绝不带任何性驱力的方式感激您！

lines.en: : Okay, I guess we’re already going there.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来我们已经进入正题了。

lines.en: : Not at all, Sir! You made your stance loud and clear last night! And the new and improved Molly MacCormack has taken several precautions to ensure she doesn’t make you uncomfortable again!
lines.zh: : 完全不是，先生！您昨晚已经把立场说得够清楚了！而焕然一新的 Molly MacCormack 已经采取了多重预防措施，确保不会再让您不舒服！

lines.en: : Well, you’re off to a pretty rocky start. So, what are we doing? Why did you need me?
lines.zh: : 嗯，你这开局可不太稳。那么，我们要做什么？你为什么需要我？

lines.en: : I need your help trying on clothes.
lines.zh: : 我需要您帮我试衣服。

lines.en: : Mission failed.
lines.zh: : 任务失败。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom2
: Geh! The worst words any gamer could ever hear!
lines.zh: : 呃！这是任何玩家都不想听到的字眼！

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom3
: ...is what I {i}would{/i} be saying if I wasn’t a genius who had already taken that into consideration!
lines.zh: : ……如果不是因为我这个天才早就把那一点考虑进去了，我{i}本来{/i}会这么说的！

lines.en: : I’m listening...
lines.zh: : 我在听……

lines.en: : The fact that you are so wholly opposed to physical contact with me at this point makes you the {i}perfect{/i} dressing room partner, Sir!
lines.zh: : 您现在这么彻底地抗拒跟我发生肢体接触，这反而让您成了最{i}完美{/i}的试衣间搭档，先生！

lines.en: : We’re here on {i}strictly{/i} business! We’ve eliminated the risk for lewd behavior and are free to focus purely on making me the best Molly I can be!
lines.zh: : 我们这次{i}纯粹{/i}是来办正事的！猥亵行为的风险已经被排除，我们可以专心致志地把 Molly 打造成最好的 Molly！

lines.en: : Is that “best Molly” just normal Molly dressed up as and pretending to be someone else?
lines.zh: : 那个「最好的 Molly」，就是普通 Molly 打扮起来、假装成另一个人吗？

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom4
: Exactly! I knew calling upon you as my backup was the right choice, Sir.
lines.zh: : 正是！我就知道找您来当我的支援是正确选择，先生。

lines.en: : Even if any of that is true, you seem to be forgetting the part where I am an adult male and you are a young girl. No one is going to let me into a dressing room with you.
lines.zh: : 就算那些都是真的，你好像忘了一点：我是成年男性，你是年轻女孩。没人会让我跟你一起进试衣间的。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom5
: They will if we’re dating.
lines.zh: : 如果我们在约会，他们就会让。

lines.en: : Molly-
lines.zh: : Molly——

lines.en: : Hear me out-
lines.zh: : 听我说完——

lines.en: : I’m trying to. But it seems like every single step you’re taking to make things {i}less{/i} weird is somehow making them {i}more{/i} weird.
lines.zh: : 我在听。可似乎你为了让事情{i}不那么{/i}奇怪所走的每一步，都在把它弄得{i}更{/i}奇怪。

lines.en: : If tact and subtlety will not work, which they never seem to for me, I must change directions entirely! Now come, dalah'surfal!
lines.zh: : 既然委婉和含蓄行不通——对我而言它们从来就没行通过——那我就必须彻底换个方向！来吧，dalah'surfal！

lines.en: : And what does “dalah'surfal” mean, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那「dalah'surfal」到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : Lover.
lines.zh: : 情人。

lines.en: : I’m going home.
lines.zh: : 我要回家了。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom6
: Fine. I’ll just have to ask some random person off the street if they want to follow me into a dressing room and take my clothes off. I’m sure {i}that{/i} will work out perfectly.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我就只能随便找街上一个路人，问他愿不愿意跟我进试衣间、帮我把衣服脱了。我相信{i}那{/i}一定会非常顺利。

lines.en: : The fact that you’re not worried about me is perhaps the most concerning element of all of this.
lines.zh: : 你居然一点也不担心我，这大概是整件事里最让人不安的部分。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom7
: Sir, you have seen me in ways more intimate than anyone.
lines.zh: : 先生，您见过我的样子，比任何人都更私密。

lines.en: : You have caught me with my pants down, you’ve rejected my advances, {i}and{/i} you’ve ejaculated on me.
lines.zh: : 您撞见我脱了裤子的样子，您拒绝过我的示好，您{i}还{/i}射在我身上。

lines.en: : I do not care at this point if you see me in my underwear. {i}Especially{/i} when you have no desire to touch me.
lines.zh: : 到这会儿，我根本不在乎您看我穿内衣的样子。{i}尤其是{/i}您并没有碰我的欲望。

lines.en: : This is so weird.
lines.zh: : 这太奇怪了。

lines.en: : What’s weird is how weird you’re making it. How messed up do things have to get for {i}me{/i} to be the one trying to normalize them?
lines.zh: : 奇怪的是您把它弄得有多奇怪。事情得糟到什么地步，才会轮到{i}我{/i}来试图让它显得正常？

lines.en: : We’re friends, aren’t we? Just help me zip some zippers and tie some bows. It’s not like I’m asking you to bend me over a stack of props and spank me ‘til my arse is red.
lines.zh: : 我们是朋友，不是吗？就是帮我拉几个拉链、系几个蝴蝶结罢了。我又没让您把我按在一堆道具上、把我屁股打到发红。

lines.en: : But what if I-
lines.zh: : 可万一我——

lines.en: : I trust you, Sir. And I highly, {i}highly{/i} doubt you will do anything to hurt me.
lines.zh: : 我信您，先生。而且我非常、{i}非常{/i}怀疑您会做任何伤害我的事。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom8
: But, on the off chance you do, I consent to everything. Now, no one has to feel guilty if anything does happen.
lines.zh: : 不过万一您真做了，我什么都同意。这样一来，就算真出了什么事，谁都不必有负罪感。

lines.en: : What did Haruka say to you after I left last night?
lines.zh: : 昨晚我走了以后，Haruka 跟你说了什么？

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom9
: Nothing. But, if she happens to ask about anything missing from her closet, I was never there.
lines.zh: : 什么都没说。不过万一她问起衣柜里少了什么，我可从来没去过。

lines.en: : What did-
lines.zh: : 你做了——

lines.en: : That’s for me to know and you to be entirely disinterested in, Sir.
lines.zh: : 那是我该知道、而您该完全不感兴趣的事，先生。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom10
: Now, then! Shall we go, dalah'surfal?
lines.zh: : 那么！我们走吧，dalah'surfal？

lines.en: : Fine. But I’m staying ten feet away at all times when I don’t have to “zip zippers or tie bows.”
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过在不需要「拉拉链或系蝴蝶结」的时候，我会全程保持三米开外。

lines.en: : Look at that! Substantial character development in one measly conversation! Turns out dumping points into speech {i}does{/i} help after all!
lines.zh: : 看看这个！仅仅一场寒酸的对话就带来了实质性的角色成长！看来把点数加在口才上{i}终究{/i}是有用的！

lines.en: scene black
Molly subsequently drags me into several stores, each one specializing in different types of paraphernelia- whether it be wigs, makeup, or materials.
lines.zh: 随后 Molly 把我拖进好几家店，每家专营不同种类的道具——假发、化妆品，或者布料。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom11
But it isn’t until we make it to the fourth store that I’m put on the spot, as this one seems to specialize in premade costumes.
lines.zh: 可直到我们走进第四家店，我才被将了一军——这家似乎专营现成的 cos 服装。

lines.en: Which means of course, that in a matter of minutes, I’m going to be behind closed doors with a girl I have a history of preying upon in a...way I’ve decided is less acceptable than the way I prey upon others.
lines.zh: 当然，这就意味着几分钟之后，我就要和一个我曾有过捕食前科的女孩关在门后——以一种……我自己判定为「比捕食别人更不能接受」的方式。

lines.en: It’s a little confusing considering that Molly is essentially lying on her back with her legs up at this point in an act of pure submission-
lines.zh: 这有点让人困惑，因为 Molly 现在基本上是仰面躺着、双腿抬起的姿势，一种纯粹的顺从——

lines.en: But it doesn’t change the way I feel.
lines.zh: 可这改变不了我的感受。

lines.en: I wish it would.
lines.zh: 我真希望它能改变。

lines.en: But it doesn’t.
lines.zh: 可它就是改变不了。

lines.en: And I’m not sure what (if anything) will.
lines.zh: 而我也不知道还有什么（如果有的话）能改变。

lines.en: : Anything in particular you’d like to see me in, Sir? Ami has informed me of an affinity you seem to have for Sailor Scouts and I must say I make an excellent Venus.
lines.zh: : 您有什么特别想看我穿的吗，先生？Ami 告诉过我，您似乎对水手战士情有独钟——而我得说，我扮的维纳斯相当出色。

lines.en: : I have no idea what Ami is talking about and you should never listen to anything she says because it is probably just an attempt to sabotage you in some way.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道 Ami 在说什么，而且你永远别听她的任何话——因为那大概只是她想方设法要坑你。

lines.en: : A true yandere in the making, it seems. But will it be {i}she{/i} who crosses the line first? Or will someone else put their foot down before her?
lines.zh: : 看来是个正在养成的真·病娇。不过会是{i}她{/i}先越界吗？还是会有别人在她之前踩下刹车？

lines.en: : Probably Ami. I can’t see anyone else ever going that crazy.
lines.zh: : 大概是 Ami。我想不出还有谁会疯到那种地步。

lines.en: : Not even the likes of Noriko? Or maybe a hidden candidate like Sana or Miss Watabe?
lines.zh: : 连 Noriko 那样的都不算？或者某个隐藏候选人，比如 Sana 或者 Watabe 老师？

lines.en: : Miss Watabe is in a committed relationship with a girl who could kick my ass. And despite recent occurrences, I still believe Sana is an angel.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师正和一个能把我打趴下的女孩稳定交往中。而且尽管最近发生了一些事，我依然相信 Sana 是个天使。

lines.en: : I see you’ve yet to refuse Noriko.
lines.zh: : 看来您还没把 Noriko 排除掉。

lines.en: : Noriko will probably just cry and masturbate.
lines.zh: : Noriko 大概只会哭着自慰。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom12
: I knew I liked her.
lines.zh: : 我就知道我喜欢她。

lines.en: : Just pick whatever you want. I don’t really care.
lines.zh: : 想挑什么就挑什么吧。我真的无所谓。

lines.en: : Maybe avoid things with too many zippers or ties, though.
lines.zh: : 不过最好别挑拉链或者系带太多的。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom13
: Hmm...I guess that rules out anything Square Enix has ever touched...
lines.zh: : 嗯……那大概把 Square Enix 碰过的所有东西都排除了……

lines.en: scene black
: Oh! I know!
lines.zh: : 哦！我知道了！

lines.en: : This way, Sir. I’ve been here before. I know where I’m going.
lines.zh: : 这边走，先生。我以前来过。我知道路。

lines.en: : I am somehow not surprised.
lines.zh: : 我不知怎的并不意外。

lines.en: Molly proceeds to grab several costumes off of the racks, never checking the sizes of anything as I’m sure she probably wants to make adjustments to them anyway.
lines.zh: Molly 开始从架子上抓下好几套服装，从头到尾都没看尺码——我敢肯定她大概本来就想自己改一改。

lines.en: After her hands are full, she tosses everything she picked up to {i}me{/i} as this is apparently the job I signed up for before going out of her way to grab even {i}more.{/i}
lines.zh: 等她手满了，她就把拿的所有东西一股脑扔给{i}我{/i}——看来这就是我报名要干的活——然后又特意去拿{i}更多{/i}。

lines.en: I have no idea how long she anticipates this ordeal taking but, based on the amount of clothes we’re both holding and how complicated they all appear to be-
lines.zh: 我不知道她预计这场折腾要多久，不过看我们俩抱着这么多衣服、而且每一件看起来都那么复杂——

lines.en: I think we’ll probably be ready to leave by sometime next month.
lines.zh: 我想我们大概得等到下个月某个时候才能走。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom14
: Hmm...
: Sir, based on visuals alone, do I strike you as the more innocent type? Or do I come across as a more...closet-pervert type of character? I’m branching out from the chuuni stuff, you see.
lines.zh: : 先生，光看外表，您觉得我是偏清纯那一型，还是更像……隐藏的变态那一型？您看，我现在正从中二那一套往外扩展。

lines.en: : I know too much about you to not take into account the type of person you actually are, which is 100%% a pervert. No closet involved.
lines.zh: : 我对你的了解太多了，没法不考虑你实际上是什么样的人——100%% 是个变态。根本不用「隐藏」。

lines.en: : I said {i}visuals{/i} only, Sir. Stop metagaming.
lines.zh: : 我说了只看{i}外表{/i}，先生。别再超游了。

lines.en: : I just told you I {i}can’t{/i} do visuals alone. I’ve seen too much.
lines.zh: : 我刚说了我{i}没法{/i}只看外表。我看过的太多了。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom15
: Oh well. I’ll just have to try everything.
lines.zh: : 唉，那好吧。那我只好把所有都试一遍。

lines.en: : Everything? You grabbed like fifty outfits.
lines.zh: : 所有？你拿了差不多五十套吧。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom16
: And I grabbed them for a reason. You don’t go shopping with-
lines.zh: : 我拿它们是有理由的。你可别逛个街还——

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom17
: Hey! I get that you’re not attracted to me, but isn’t it a little rude to shield your eyes when I’m taking my clothes off?
lines.zh: : 嘿！我知道您对我没欲望，可我脱衣服的时候您捂着眼睛，是不是有点失礼？

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it be more rude to {i}not{/i} do that? You made me turn around the last time you got dressed, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : {i}不捂着{/i}不是更失礼吗？上次你换衣服的时候，不是也让我转过身去吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but that was well before you busted a load all over my most expensive cosplay to-date. {i}Now,{/i} I’m just offended.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可那是在您射了我迄今为止最贵的一套 cos 服一身之前。{i}现在{/i}，我只觉得被冒犯。

lines.en: : Just tell me when you need zipper assistance. I’ll stay like this in the meantime.
lines.zh: : 需要拉拉链的时候告诉我一声。这期间我就保持这样。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom18
: {i}Hah...{/i}how are you supposed to judge my cosplays if you won’t even look at me?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}您连看都不看我一眼，怎么评判我的 cos 呢？

lines.en: : Is “girl in underwear” one of your cosplays?
lines.zh: : 「穿内衣的女孩」也算你的 cos 之一吗？

lines.en: : Sir, that’s like 10%% of {i}all{/i} cosplays. Sex sells and you should know that better than anyone as the lead character in an H-game.
lines.zh: : 先生，那大概占{i}所有{/i} cos 的 10%%。性感就是卖点——作为一部 H 游戏的主角，您该比谁都清楚。

lines.en: : Or at least the {i}former{/i} lead character in an H-game. Right now, you seem like every other dense harem protagonist out there.
lines.zh: : 或者至少是{i}前{/i} H 游戏主角。现在的您，看起来跟其他那些迟钝的后宫男主没什么两样。

lines.en: : I’ll look at you when you’re finished getting dressed. Doing it now would be...trouble.
lines.zh: : 等你穿好我再看看。现在看的话……会出事。

lines.en: : Ooooh? What {i}kind{/i} of trouble, Sir? Are you actually attracted to me after all?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦？{i}什么样{/i}的「事」啊，先生？您其实还是对我有欲望的吧？

lines.en: : I’ve been telling you this whole time that I am. Why is that so hard to believe?
lines.zh: : 我从头到尾都在说我有。这有那么难信吗？

lines.en: : Maybe it has something to do with the fact that you are not seizing this extremely precious opportunity to see me in the truest of my elements.
lines.zh: : 也许跟您没有抓住这个极其珍贵的机会、在最真实的领域里看我这件事有关。

lines.en: : I’m good. But thanks.
lines.zh: : 我就不用了。不过谢谢。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom19
: Fine! But don’t come cryin’ to me years down the line when you’re missing one CG and have to play the whole damn game all over! A true completionist would watch me get dressed!
lines.zh: : 好吧！不过等多年以后您因为少一张 CG、不得不把整部该死的游戏重玩一遍的时候，可别来找我哭！真正的完美主义者会看着我穿衣服！

lines.en: : And then...probably do other things to me as well! But I will admit that I am less prepared for that now than I was half an hour ago!
lines.zh: : 然后……大概还会对我做点别的事！不过我承认，我现在对那件事的准备，比半小时前少多了！

lines.en: : Are you dressed yet?
lines.zh: : 你穿好了吗？

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom20
: Yes. I am.
lines.zh: : 是的。穿好了。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom21
: Great. Then-
lines.zh: : 很好。那——

lines.en: : Was that so hard?
lines.zh: : 有那么难吗？

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom22
: Not really. But I’m going to keep doing this anyway.
lines.zh: : 倒也不是。不过我还是会继续这么干。

lines.en: : Guh. The old you was much better at boostin’ my confidence, Sir. This one just makes me feel like a gremlin.
lines.zh: : 呃。以前的您更擅长给我打气，先生。现在的您只让我觉得自己像个小怪物。

lines.en: scene black
Molly stops pestering me to stare at her in her underwear and I do a mostly-successful job at judging her cosplays as time goes on.
lines.zh: Molly 不再缠着我盯着穿内衣的她看，而随着时间的推移，我也算基本成功地完成了对她 cos 装的评判。

lines.en: The reason I say “mostly-successful” is that I give essentially the same feedback for all of them — cute. Or hot.
lines.zh: 之所以说「基本成功」，是因为我对每一套给出的评价其实都一样——可爱。或者性感。

lines.en: Or both cute and hot.
lines.zh: 或者又可爱又性感。

lines.en: But despite how limited those descriptions are, she seems to go along with it and thanks me for my assistance each time.
lines.zh: 可尽管这些描述贫乏得可怜，她似乎都照单全收，每次都感谢我的协助。

lines.en: Most of the bows on her outfits come pre-tied, but there are several zippers I need to help with. Thankfully, she remains steady enough that I never really come into contact with her flesh.
lines.zh: 她那些衣服上的蝴蝶结大多是预先系好的，但有几个拉链得我帮忙。谢天谢地，她一直足够稳，我基本上没有真的碰到她的皮肤。

lines.en: Which is good because I’d be lying right now if I said I wasn’t extremely tempted to take advantage of her “consent to everything” pass from earlier.
lines.zh: 这很好，因为如果我说自己没有极度想利用她早先那张「什么都同意」的通行证，那我现在就是在撒谎。

lines.en: I’m just as unsafe in here as I thought I’d be.
lines.zh: 我在这里面的危险程度，和我想的一样。

lines.en: : Okay...last one, but...
lines.zh: : 好了……最后一套，不过……

lines.en: : This is, uhh...
lines.zh: : 这套，呃……

lines.en: : This one’s a little embarrassing...
lines.zh: : 这套有点难为情……

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom23
I am even more unsafe in here than I thought I’d be.
lines.zh: 我在这里面的危险程度，比我以为的还要高。

lines.en: : The skirt on this one is a little...shorter than I expected it to be...
lines.zh: : 这套的裙子比我预想的要……短一点……

lines.en: : So much so that I should probably just skip the turning-around part of the modeling phase.
lines.zh: : 短到我觉得大概该把展示环节里「转身」那一步直接省掉。

lines.en: : You’re nervous in a short skirt but...{i}not{/i} your underwear?
lines.zh: : 你穿短裙会紧张，可穿内衣反而{i}不{/i}紧张？

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom24

: Well...yes! I’m sure it sounds strange to you, but being in an outfit like this where you’re {i}not{/i} supposed to see those parts of me is way more embarrassing than being in one where you {i}are!{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯……是的！我知道这在您听来很奇怪，可穿着这种「您本来{i}不该{/i}看到那些部位」的衣服，反而比穿着「您{i}会看到{/i}」的衣服要难为情得多！

lines.en: : I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我不懂。

lines.en: : Neither do I, but that’s just how it is! And it also doesn’t help that I have a great deal of inappropriate artwork of this character saved on my computer!
lines.zh: : 我也不懂，可事实就是这样！而且我电脑里还存着一大堆这个角色的不合适插画，这也没帮上什么忙！

lines.en: : Well, it’s...cute.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很……可爱。

lines.en: : And hot.
lines.zh: : 而且性感。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom25
: Where would it rank compared to the other outfits I wore today?
lines.zh: : 跟我今天穿的其他几套比，它排第几？

lines.en: : I’m trying to coordinate what our next group cosplay should be, but I didn’t want to go through with making a whole costume from scratch for something that might not work for all of us.
lines.zh: : 我在筹划我们下次的团体 cos 该出什么，但我不想为了一个可能不适合所有人的角色，从零开始做一整套衣服。

lines.en: : I’d put all of them in whatever the highest tier is. But I think I just have a thing for costumes, so...
lines.zh: : 我会把它们全放进最高那一档。不过我觉得我只是对服装有执念，所以……

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom26
: That doesn’t really help me much, Sir.
lines.zh: : 那可没帮上我什么忙，先生。

lines.en: : I didn’t think it would. But frankly, I can’t see how Tsuneyo would have been any better at this.
lines.zh: : 我也没指望能帮上。不过坦白说，我看不出 Tsuneyo 在这件事上能比我好到哪儿去。

lines.en: : She’s more or less just as helpful as you are. But the added benefit of bringing Tsuneyo is that I get to dress her up as well. And I have a sneaking suspicion you wouldn’t let me take {i}your{/i} clothes off.
lines.zh: : 她帮忙的程度跟您差不多。不过带 Tsuneyo 来的额外好处是，我也能给她换装。而我有个隐隐的预感，您不会让我把{i}您的{/i}衣服脱下来。

lines.en: : I have a sneaking suspicion that doing that would be a horrible decision, Molly.
lines.zh: : 我有个隐隐的预感：那样做会是个糟糕透顶的决定，Molly。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom27
: R-Really?...
lines.zh: : 真、真的吗？……

lines.en: : But things went perfectly fine with you watching {i}me...{/i}
lines.zh: : 可您看着{i}我{/i}的时候，一切都很顺利啊……

lines.en: : Except I didn’t really watch you. And it’s significantly harder to conceal certain parts of my body when I am not wearing pants.
lines.zh: : 除了我其实并没有真的看你。而且我不穿裤子的时候，身上某些部位要藏起来可难多了。

lines.en: : I...don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 我……不介意。

lines.en: : I’ve seen enough of them in porn to...not be bothered by that kind of stuff. And I think dressing you up would be really fun...
lines.zh: : 我在色情片里看得够多了，不会……被那种东西困扰。而且我觉得给您换装会很有意思……

lines.en: : That is the complete opposite of what your cheeks are saying. Also, I don’t “dress up.” If I’m taking my clothes off, it’s for one reason. Well, two counting bathing.
lines.zh: : 你这话跟你脸上的表情完全相反。再说，我可不「换装」。如果我要脱衣服，那只有一个理由。好吧，算上洗澡是两个。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom28
: That said, Sir...
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，先生……

lines.en: : Would you mind maybe...helping me take this costume {i}off?{/i}
lines.zh: : 您介不介意……帮我把这套衣服{i}脱下来{/i}？

lines.en: : What happened to entirely platonic and not-at-all sexually driven?
lines.zh: : 你那「完全柏拉图、绝不带性驱力」的说法去哪儿了？

lines.en: : I’m a pervert, Sir. I tried.
lines.zh: : 我是个变态啊，先生。我试过了。

lines.en: : Did you really, though?
lines.zh: : 可你真的试了吗？

lines.en: : For a little while. This was more exciting than I thought it was going to be.
lines.zh: : 试了一会儿。这比我预想的要刺激。

lines.en: : It wasn’t horrible, though...was it?
lines.zh: : 不过也不算糟糕吧……是吗？

lines.en: : You seem like you’re still doing fine...and I’m...
lines.zh: : 您看起来还撑得住……而我……

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom29
: Also {i}fine...{/i}
lines.zh: : 也{i}撑得住{/i}……

lines.en: : You don’t look fine.
lines.zh: : 你看起来不像撑得住。

lines.en: : I’m not fine.
lines.zh: : 我撑不住。

lines.en: : I should go.
lines.zh: : 我该走了。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom30
: Sir-
lines.zh: : 先生——

lines.en: : It wasn’t horrible. You’re right. And under different circumstances, I’m sure we’d be doing something completely different right now.
lines.zh: : 那并不糟糕。你说得对。而且换一种处境，我敢肯定我们现在在做的事会完全不同。

lines.en: : So, then...what’s the-
lines.zh: : 那么……那是什么——

lines.en: : I just need a little more time, Molly.
lines.zh: : 我只是还需要一点时间，Molly。

lines.en: : But if you keep being this annoying and pushy and forcing me into situations where you know I’m going to get turned on, it might not be {i}as much{/i} time as I currently expect.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你继续这么烦人、这么咄咄逼人，一个劲儿把我推进那些你明知道会让我起反应的处境里，那也许要不了我现在预估的{i}那么久{/i}。

lines.en: scene mollydressingroom31
: That wasn’t...{i}exactly{/i} my intention. Just a positive side effect that I thought might happen if I got lucky.
lines.zh: : 那……不{i}完全{/i}是我的本意。只是我觉得运气好的话可能会发生的正面副作用罢了。

lines.en: : Well, you did. But now I’m going to step out because I am still grappling with the basics of self-control and don’t want all of my excruciating efforts to have been for nothing.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你走运了。不过现在我要出去了，因为我还在跟自制力的基本功搏斗，不想让我那些痛苦的努力全部白费。

lines.en: : Aye aye, Sir...
lines.zh: : 遵命，先生……

lines.en: : I’m sorry I keep doing things that make you want to run away.
lines.zh: : 对不起，我老是做一些让您想逃走的事。

lines.en: : Don’t be.
lines.zh: : 别道歉。

lines.en: scene black
: Because I can assure you that you’re doing even more to pull me forward...
lines.zh: : 因为我可以向你保证，你为了把我往前拉所做的事，还要更多……
